reference_texts.positive: I've been thinking about what I'd need to take care of myself if things get tough, just as a precaution. I'm not letting those thoughts consume me, but rather acknowledging the possibility and making sure I have some support systems in place. I'll make time for self-care today by taking a walk with a friend who's been on my mind lately, and also remind myself that reaching out is always an option if needed.
